test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All lemons are potatoes.

Some lemons are papayas.

Conclusions:

(I) Some potatoes are papayas.

(II) All papayas are potatoes
solution:
**Statements:**

All lemons are potatoes. 

Some lemons are papayas. 

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21646f1ca5ca9a1a32c68ad9e910d96de12a4b4f6cb41a37b5fd6bd91f9668f1.png] 

**Conclusions:**

 

(I) Some potatoes are papayas. - **True **(because All lemons are potatoes, and Some lemons are papayas given. So, Some potatoes are papayas too)

 

(II) All papayas are potatoes - **False **(because All lemons are potatoes, and Some lemons are papayas given. So, All papayas are potatoes it is not true and it can be possible only).

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion (I) follows**".
